decision_reason: Activate GCC PDP-6 O0/O1/O2/Os: original struct s has GNU unsigned 8-bit and 32-bit long-long bitfields, passes by value through f, returns struct, and main asserts a==12, b==0xcdef1234. All four GCC passes with real field assignments and abort checks. KCC does not accept GNU long long bitfields.

Activate GCC PDP-6 O0/O1/O2/Os with limited termination oracle: GNU statement-expression local label loops x from 1 to 3 before explicit exit(0), O0/O2 emitted loops remain. No explicit abort and unused char big[0x1000]; do not claim big-array integrity or independent local-label value assertion. KCC GNU statement-expression/local-label syntax unsupported.

Retain hosted-runtime: original sprintf via function pointer formats double 5.0 to precise bytes 5 and NUL with explicit abort. GCC PDP-6 O0 cannot compile missing stdio.h/sprintf declaration; KCC noopt cannot link real sprintf. Cannot replace formatted output with stub without weakening varargs ABI oracle.

Activate GCC/KCC: v=1 selects literal abc from f(), verified through real installed strcmp; main aborts if incorrect. KCC PDP-6 noopt/optimized PASS, GCC O0 PASS but GCC O1/O2/Os RUN_FAIL; record true optimizer failures. Alternative g/f1 paths not executed.

Activate KCC/GCC in 10000-value bounded range: f(i) uses original 32-bit reciprocal 0xAAAAAAAB and 71-bit multiply/shift to check i/3 for i=0..9999; KCC noopt/optimized and GCC O0/O1/O2/Os all PASS. It does not establish full native 36-bit unsigned division over arbitrary inputs; source constants and assertions unmodified.

Retain trampoline compiler investigation: GNU nested t0/t1/t2 and callbacks lack explicit abort/callback counter, GCC PDP-6 O0 compiles/links but simulator times out rc=124 with no readable exit status. KCC rejects nested functions. No passing callback oracle; preserve source for later focused strengthening and compiler fix.

Retain nonasserting source: original signed short bitfields in array are assigned zero to static zero-initialized storage, and main simply exits with no readback or abort. GCC PDP-6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS but cannot establish correct field writes; KCC rejects short bitfield declaration. Preserve source for later meaningful assertion addition instead of promoting vacuous passes.

Retain hosted allocator/runtime: original malloc creates volatile foo_t, accesses a/b, conditionally printf, checks b==0x0100. GCC PDP-6 O0 cannot compile installed missing stdio.h; KCC noopt links fail on printf or allocation prerequisite. No dummy allocator or suppressed print acceptable for original oracle.

Activate GCC PDP-6 O0/O1/O2/Os: original GNU inline f(3) alloca int space, writes value, reads it and g asserts x==3; actual gcc O0 asm retains stack allocation/write/read and abort. GCC all four PASS, KCC rejects trailing top-level null declaration/inline dialect, not evidence of GCC failure. Original source unchanged.

Activate KCC/GCC narrow long-ABI oracle: main sets el=0, parsefile->fd=0xdeadbeefL and calls f(), which takes g2(long a), asserts exact arg and calls exit(0). KCC PDP-6 noopt/optimized and GCC O0/O1/O2/Os PASS; strcpy/g1 branch is unreachable for these inputs, so no string-copy correctness claim. No source modifications.
